_comment: All tunable clinical/ML thresholds in one place. Edit and restart the backend. Values are engineering defaults, not clinically validated cut-offs.

quality._note: sharpness = variance of the Laplacian measured at 1024 px width; real panoramic radiographs in DP_datasets measured 38-110. blur_reject lowered from 10 to 3 on 2026-10-07: 4.5 % of real DenPAR periapical test films measured 3-10 (minimum over 1,000 films 2.9) and the model's bone-loss error on them was lower than average (3.9 vs 6.8 points); films blurred with sigma >= 6 measure <= 3.4. Films between 3 and 25 still get the blur warning, which sends the case to review.
